title: Made a retro arcade seagull simulator but its missing some juice n' spice - help me improve it!!
author: KlutzyAd5743
selftext:
I've been working on a little browser game where you are a stealing seagull, having a lot of fun vibe coding it but not many people have been interested in playing it. The basic loop is there: fly around, steal food to win points, repeat. The visuals are pretty janky but the main thing I'm not convinced about is that there's no mechanic that makes people say "just one more round." 

The scoring system is pretty old school 'high scores' for food you eat - but I'm wondering if theres a more interesting approach with 'terror points' for causing chaos, ruckus, etc. 

So If you were developing this, what would you add? Different approach altogether? Or more enemy types, unpredictable events, , or something completely different? I'd genuinely appreciate some outside perspectives.

Demo here [https://capddd.itch.io/gullinit](https://capddd.itch.io/gullinit) thanks and KEEE-oww
